title: Web - Browser RUM enriched LCP missing

model.expr: (sum (count_over_time({service_name="tuist-web"} | logfmt | kind="measurement" | type="web-vitals" | app_environment="prod" | lcp!="" | __error__="" | context_rum_schema="1" [2h]))) or vector(0)

annotations.summary: No enriched production LCP samples for two hours
annotations.description: Checks pipeline liveness independently of percentile eligibility. Keep the existing raw-ingestion missing-data alert too. Only enable after gateway rollout. Healthy low-volume surfaces may be absent from the per-surface rules. The sum intentionally has no grouping labels so the zero fallback is replaced by a healthy result instead of producing an extra always-firing instance.

annotations.description: Six-hour fraction of raw production LCP reports with missing or untracked deduplication context. IDs must be bounded, nonempty and not the unknown sentinel.
